titulo: Using the simple future for probability and predictions in the future
subtitulo: Llegaré como a las doce: what will happen, what probably will, and what someone predicts.
regla: The simple future expresses what will happen, what probably will happen, and predictions: estarán ocupados; habrá coches voladores.

bloques.texto: The simple future says what **will happen**, soon or far away in time: **mañana será un gran día**, **dentro de dos años estaré en la universidad**. The speaker feels quite sure.
It also has two more jobs: **probability**, something that _might_ happen, and **prediction**, what someone foresees.

filas: Llegaré como a las doce o doce y media.

bloques.texto: With probability, either the tone sounds doubtful, or something in the sentence makes it a guess. It's as if an unspoken phrase were there: **lo más probable es que…**, **no me extrañaría que…**, **supongo que…**
Often the first part of the sentence gives the reason, and the second part, in the future, gives the guess or prediction: **es muy ambicioso; será rico, sin duda**.
Tip: think of the future as a fortune teller. Sometimes she's sure, sometimes she's guessing, but she always speaks in the future.

lista.es: Tengo mucho trabajo, así que ==llegaré== como a las doce.
lista.en: I'm very busy, so I'll probably get there around twelve.

lista.es: Hay un choque ahí; ==tendrán== que llamar a la policía.
lista.en: There's a crash there; they'll probably have to call the police.
They're not answering; they're probably in the water.

lista.es: La adivina me dijo: «==Conocerás== a alguien que te cambiará la vida».
lista.en: The fortune teller told me: "You'll meet someone who will change your life."

lista.es: Con tanta tecnología, en 2050 ==habrá== carros voladores.
lista.en: With so much technology, there will be flying cars in 2050.

lista.es: Entrena todos los días; ==será== cinta negra pronto.
lista.en: He trains every day; he'll be a black belt soon.

bloques.texto: Probability in the **future** and probability in the **present** look the same. **Estarán ocupados** can mean _they'll probably be busy_ or _they're probably busy right now_; context decides.

lista.nota: Right now, probably: see [[5060|probability in the present]].

lista.texto: Guessing about now: [[5060|the future for probability in the present]].
The future of **hay**: [[5157|haber in the future]].
Plans in everyday speech: [[7067|ir a + infinitive]].

bloques.texto: Say it out loud, then open the answer.

lista.p: In Spanish: _There's a lot of traffic; they'll probably arrive late._
Predict: _In ten years there will be gardens on every roof._
lista.r: En diez años habrá huertos en todas las azoteas.

lista.p: In Spanish: _She's very good; she'll win, no doubt._
lista.r: Es muy buena; ganará, sin duda.
